name: Brandon Gill
bio: a Representative from Texas; born in Clovis, Curry County, N.Mex., February 26, 1994; graduated from Eula High School, Clyde, Tex., 2012; B.A., Dartmouth College, Hanover, N.H., 2016; investment banker; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
